description: Comprehensive guide to obtaining veteran records and updating service documentation. 7 categories: DD-214 / discharge documents (NPRC eVetRecs + paper SF-180 + state alternatives), Service Treatment Records (eBenefits + paper SF-180), VA ID Cards (VIC + VHIC distinction), Military Awards verification, Replacement Medals (per-branch), Discharge Upgrades (DRB + BCMR + Liberal Consideration), Records Correction (DD-149). Each: plain-English steps, form numbers, URLs, turnaround.

type.description: Optional — return just one category. Omit for all 7.

title: Get military and VA records
